One year ago, George Floyd was senselessly killed at the hands of police. He should still be alive today.

Though his murderer was convicted, we all must continue to fight for full justice. Too many Black lives are taken due to systemic racism & violence. #BlackLivesMatter

As we mark one year since George Floyd was murdered, @AlphonsoDavid poignantly reflects on the past year & how much work still needs to be done to transform our police force that systemically dehumanizes people, especially Black people. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/npNXBRfxwX
